focus: security: trust_boundary_scan, Python twin of G5-I5-P2-001, P1 recheck

findingDetails.title: Hook metrics store writes on every prompt into a shared temp folder with no owner, mode or symlink check, so another local user can redirect the append and chmod onto any victim-owned file
findingDetails.scopeProof: metrics.ts and user-prompt-submit.ts are in reviewScopeFiles; probe imported the built dist export and wrote only under /private/tmp/dr-iter6
findingDetails.case: Linux host with tmpdir()=/tmp; another account pre-creates /tmp/speckit-skill-advisor-metrics 0755 with a symlink <sha256(workspace)[0:16]>-diagnostics.jsonl -> ~/.bashrc; the next Claude prompt appends a JSON line to ~/.bashrc and chmods it 0600
findingDetails.claim: metrics.ts writes by default into tmpdir()/speckit-skill-advisor-metrics with no owner/mode/symlink check; a failed folder chmod does not stop the append and file chmod, which follow a final-name symlink
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: grep lstat/getuid/uid/O_NOFOLLOW in metrics.ts (none); writer not debug-gated (requireDebug:false); macOS tmpdir per-user; sibling stores route-receipt.ts:282-290 and directive-lifecycle-store.py:38-41 do check
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: macOS per-user TMPDIR is not exposed; content is closed-schema, so impact is integrity damage plus chmod, not code execution
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade to P2 if the runtime is documented and enforced macOS-only with per-user TMPDIR, or every supported host sets a per-user TMPDIR before the hook runs

results.summary: metrics.ts:172 says only the owner may read the logs; :259-276 admits a foreign-owned folder
